note: Captured once from the published effect-dynamodb@1.39.0 and @1.40.0 (with @effect-dynamodb/schema at the same version and effect@4.1.2), installed outside the repo and run by a scratch script against DynamoDB Local at a test clock set to 1700000000000 ms: never regenerate or "fix" it. An aggregate whose dates are declared Schema.optional around epoch encodings (helpers/AggregateOptionalDates.ts): a root due (DateEpochMs) and createdAt / updatedAt (DateEpochMs, stamped), a one edge due (DateEpochSeconds), a many element due (DateEpochMs) and a sub-aggregate due (DateTimeUtc storedAs DateEpochMs), with the collection and list sort keys over the root due (`passed`) or over createdAt and updatedAt (`stamp`). Each step: its outcome (a date as { date }), the requests it sent (the table name as <table>) and the table rows after it. Both published versions stored each of these dates as ISO text; 1.39.0 refused the `stamp` shape (its create failed before sending).
